questions.question: You are the team leader of a critical government project with a deadline approaching in just three days. The project involves coordination among multiple departments, and the final submission has to be presented directly to senior officials. On the second last day, you discover that one of your most efficient team members has suddenly fallen ill and is hospitalised. Meanwhile, another member is refusing to work overtime, citing personal family issues. To make matters worse, the IT system crashes for several hours, delaying progress further. At the same time, the senior officer in charge calls you and informs that the deadline cannot be extended under any circumstances, and failure to deliver will directly affect your career and team’s reputation. In this situation, what will you do?

questions.question: A company claims that working from home has improved employee productivity by reducing commute time and allowing flexible schedules. But many employees report feelings of isolation and lack of team coordination. The company still insists remote work is the future of employment. Question: Which of the following, if true, would most weaken the company’s claim?
questions.questionHtml:
A company claims that working from home has improved employee productivity by reducing commute time and allowing flexible schedules. But many employees report feelings of isolation and lack of team coordination. The company still insists remote work is the future of employment.

Question: Which of the following, if true, would most weaken the company’s claim?

options.text: Studies reveal that prolonged remote work reduces collaboration and innovation within teams.
options.html: Studies reveal that prolonged remote work reduces collaboration and innovation within teams.

options.text: Employees save significant expenses on travel and food while working from home.
options.html: Employees save significant expenses on travel and food while working from home.

options.text: Some organisations have adopted hybrid models combining office and remote work.
options.html: Some organisations have adopted hybrid models combining office and remote work.

options.text: Employees working remotely report better work-life balance.
options.html: Employees working remotely report better work-life balance.

questions.solution:
a) Studies reveal that prolonged remote work reduces collaboration and innovation within teams. This directly weakens the claim because if remote work reduces collaboration and innovation, then productivity may actually fall instead of rising.
b) Employees save significant expenses on travel and food while working from home. This supports the claim rather than weakening it, because it shows another benefit of remote work.
c) Some organisations have adopted hybrid models combining office and remote work. This is neutral, as it simply shows an alternative but does not prove that WFH reduces productivity.
d) Employees working remotely report better work-life balance. This also supports the claim since better work-life balance can lead to higher productivity.

questions.question: In a row of students, Ramesh is 15th from the left end, Suresh is 18th from the right end, and there are 9 students between them. Questions: 1. How many students are there in the row? 2. What is the position of Suresh from the left end?
questions.questionHtml:
In a row of students, Ramesh is 15th from the left end, Suresh is 18th from the right end, and there are 9 students between them.
Questions:
1. How many students are there in the row?
2. What is the position of Suresh from the left end?
questions.solution:
Total = Left position + Right position + Between = 15 + 18 + 9 = 42
Suresh from left = Total – Right position + 1 = 42 – 18 + 1 = 25

questions.question: If LAKSHMI is coded as 146, then how will ABHISHEK be coded?
questions.questionHtml: If LAKSHMI is coded as 146, then how will ABHISHEK be coded?
questions.solution:
Logic: (Sum of alphabet positions) × (Number of vowels)

LAKSHMI → 12+1+11+19+8+13+9 = 73, vowels = 2 → 73×2 = 146

ABHISHEK → 1+2+8+9+19+8+5+11 = 63, vowels = 3 → 63×3 = 189

questions.question: If 90% of a number is 621, what will be 50% of 20% of that number?
questions.questionHtml: If 90% of a number is 621, what will be 50% of 20% of that number?
questions.solution:
Step 1: Find the number
90% = 621
So, number = 621 ÷ 0.9 = 690

Step 2: Find 20% of the number
20% of 690 = 690 × 0.2 = 138

Step 3: Find 50% of that 20%
50% of 138 = 138 × 0.5 = 69
